name: idle-seated
story: Seated breathing idle: one slow ribcage-led breath per loop. Her eyes drop to the bump, then her near hand strokes forward over its curve; her eyes follow the hand and her smile warms as her head tips toward it in the exhale. Her head leads the way back, a blink hides her eyes lifting, the hand releases along a lower path and settles.

keys.note: hand at rest; outbound starts 3f after the eyes drop (f15)
arm-only: the wrist hugs the curve of the bump
outbound rides up over the curve of the bump
caress extreme (wrist turns at f87), lands at the end of the exhale; head/neck keys land early (measured local peaks f79/f79) so the head tip turns back at f83, ahead of the hand
release: lower hand path, fingers trailing; neck lengthens so the head lifts away on the next inhale
release lands: wrist 2 deg and head 1.2 deg past rest, both ease back
wrist settles back; moving hold across the loop seam to 0.6 s

breath.note: phase0: belly inhale peak at 1.0 s (f30), belly exhale ends f77 (chest +3f, head +7f), so the caress extreme sits in the breath pause and the head lifts away on the next inhale; f0 is a moving hold mid-inhale. Gains exaggerated past the pack (chest 2.6%) for phone legibility (critic R1-R2)

springs.note: hair below the pack range (1.5-3 Hz) on purpose so the strand tips trail the slow head moves (screen-space tip extremes ~4-9f after the head tip); damping 0.5-0.55 so they settle before the seam

events.note: as the head starts back; hides the gaze returning; opens over 8f so tender eyes don't snap wide

pins.note: pinned hands (pose fx.pinNear/pinFar) stay on the bump while breath and drift move the shoulders; ride = they rise with the bump's breath (H units at full inhale)

keys.note: eyes drop to the bump, 3f before the hand moves
eyes follow the hand forward, lids soften
eyes come back up inside the blink's closed frames
smile warms: corners up ~4.5 px, ~12% wider, cheeks lift ~6 ref px (~8 output px), lower lids squint 3.5 ref px
